svg.title: Vigilantia model comparison: accuracy and runtime
svg.desc: Benchmark test set, n=12 · no interval published: Majority baseline (classical) 0.500; Logistic regression (classical) 0.833; RBF SVM (classical) 0.917; Quantum-kernel SVM (exact simulation) 0.500; Quantum-kernel SVM (ibm_fez, uncorrected) 0.500; Quantum-kernel SVM (ibm_fez, calibrated) 0.500. External full set, n=6,441 · 95% CI, simulation only: Majority baseline (classical) 0.539 (95% CI 0.526 to 0.551); Logistic regression (classical) 0.663 (95% CI 0.651 to 0.674); RBF SVM (classical) 0.644 (95% CI 0.632 to 0.656); Quantum-kernel SVM (exact simulation) 0.522 (95% CI 0.510 to 0.535); Quantum-kernel SVM (ibm_fez, uncorrected) not run; Quantum-kernel SVM (ibm_fez, calibrated) not run. External hardware subset, n=40 · 95% CI: Majority baseline (classical) 0.500 (95% CI 0.350 to 0.650); Logistic regression (classical) 0.525 (95% CI 0.375 to 0.675); RBF SVM (classical) 0.525 (95% CI 0.375 to 0.675); Quantum-kernel SVM (exact simulation) 0.475 (95% CI 0.325 to 0.625); Quantum-kernel SVM (ibm_fez, uncorrected) 0.500 (95% CI 0.350 to 0.650); Quantum-kernel SVM (ibm_fez, calibrated) 0.525 (95% CI 0.375 to 0.675). Benchmark test set test kernel, exact simulation: 12 ms. Benchmark test set test kernel, ibm_fez execution: 89.2 s. Benchmark test set calibrated test kernel: computed from the same ibm_fez jobs as the uncorrected kernel, no extra execution. External subset test kernel, exact simulation: 21 ms. External subset test kernel, ibm_fez execution: 267.6 s. External subset calibrated test kernel: computed from the same ibm_fez jobs as the uncorrected kernel, no extra execution.
svg.text: Vigilantia: accuracy and runtime by model
Classical baselines and the hybrid quantum-kernel SVM (trained on an exact simulated kernel; hardware only classifies), on three evaluation sets.
Dot: accuracy. Line: 95% bootstrap interval where the report publishes one. Dashed line: chance level (0.5). Same trained models in every set.
Runtime to classify the evaluation set
Seconds per step, log scale. Local steps: median wall-clock time over repeated runs on one machine. IBM test kernel:
IBM's recorded execution time for the run's jobs, which also measured calibration pairs and diagonal controls. Queueing is excluded.
fit (training; quantum fit includes simulating its training kernel)
Each row changes accuracy by 8.3 points on the benchmark test set and 2.5 points on the subset; differences of one or two rows sit well inside the intervals.
The subset was drawn by a rule frozen before any result. No quantum advantage is claimed.
